# Z-X6 Display Control

> Portable Windows app for the Z-X6 GPU holder display, using sensor readings exported by AIDA64.

## Project

- Canonical landing page: https://xxyoudeadpunkxx.github.io/zx6-display-control/
- Repository and technical documentation: https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/zx6-display-control
- Current release: 0.1.0-beta.5 (public beta; unsigned executable)
- License: MIT
- Platform: Windows with .NET Framework 4.7.2 or later
- Sensor source: AIDA64 shared memory
- Source language: C# 5 / Windows Forms

## What the app controls

Two temperature readouts and two independent bars with eight levels. Users choose CPU/GPU temperature sources separately from animation sources. Bars support fill, empty, bounce, random, sensor-level, fixed-level and repeating playlist behavior. Bar response explains sensor readings, output, smoothing and range limits. Eight built-in profiles provide starting configurations. Editing one creates a personal copy. Custom profiles can be saved, duplicated, imported and exported as JSON. The app includes an animated preview of outgoing display commands, tray profile switching, guided sensor setup, a temporary bar check and optional Windows startup. The interface uses English. An optional daily startup check and a manual update check notify users about newer GitHub releases; updates are downloaded and installed by the user.

## Requirements and limits

Use one Z-X6 at a time. Other holder models and firmware variants have not been verified. The app has no controls for RGB lighting, brightness, custom images or firmware updates.

AIDA64 must be installed, running and configured to export the selected sensors through shared memory. Disable AIDA64's Turing LCD output and close the original GPU LCD utility so the serial port is available.

- [Portable Windows app](https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/zx6-display-control/releases/download/v0.1.0-beta.5/ZX6DisplayControl.zip): extract the full ZIP and keep the Core DLL beside the EXE.
- [Source archive](https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/zx6-display-control/releases/download/v0.1.0-beta.5/ZX6DisplayControl-source.zip): source, tools and documentation for the beta release.
- [Checksums](https://github.com/XxYouDeaDPunKxX/zx6-display-control/releases/download/v0.1.0-beta.5/SHA256.txt): hashes for both archives and the portable files.
